pages.text: Photosynthesis rises with light as P = I/(K + I) and falls again in light too bright, e^(−I/Ii) (photoinhibition): its best is at √(K·Ii). Carbon dioxide feeds it too; air has only 0.04%.
$(thing)Set$(): Light, Carbon dioxide.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Clouded tubes: output varies by ±2%·d.
$(thing)Limits$(): The algae burn.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): Algae near their best are fastest.
$(thing)Equations$()$(br)Photosynthesis, against its best: P/P_best = [I/(K + I)]·e^(−I/Ii)·[CO₂/(0.5 + CO₂)] / its peak
